**Status: PENDING.** No expert has reviewed any of the items below. Every lineage record carries `expert_review_status = "PENDING"` until the owner records a sign-off here and in `lineage.EXPERT_REVIEW_STATUS`.

What the expert is asked to review: (1) the **matching distance** (regime means in raw units, divided by the anchor's stored per-feature scale, optionally with a duration coordinate and a second, contextual channel) and the **identifiability gate** that decides whether a fit can be matched at all; (2) the **ladder weights and the rung definitions** that give regimes their stable names at a lineage's first fit; (3) **every threshold** that turns a distance margin into ALIGNED or CONTINUITY_UNVERIFIED, and the refit cadence that sets how far apart two matched fits are.

Marking rule: the tag `EXPERT_REVIEW(identity-distance)` stands at the start of a docstring or in a comment directly above a definition or assignment, at each place that **defines or uses** the matching distance, a ladder weight or an alignment threshold. Line numbers are left out on purpose.
